about: Saved how-tos as Buddy would record them, with questions written without seeing the phrasings Haiku writes. 'found' must replay the task; 'not_found' must fall through to the model. Half of each list tunes the thresholds, the other half reports. The fresh lists were written after the first two halves were scored and before the synonym list was added, and are reported on their own.
